title: 第643章 阿婠是你的女儿第642章 我不问你别说
lines: 戴缨将女儿安置在了侧屋，侧屋是正屋隔出的一室。
她将她小心地放在榻上，盖上薄衾，叮嘱了守夜的宫婢几句，和陆铭章出了侧屋。
天渐晚，两人没再对饮闲话，而是以香茶漱口，入榻。
陆铭章将帐幔打下，那帐幔是极轻的藕荷色纱罗，放下来的时候像一层薄薄的雾，他刚回过身，她便偎了过来，软软的臂膀环上他的腰。
“阿晏……”她喜欢这样唤他，好像这样唤一声，就能一并拥有了少年时的他和盛年时的他。
陆铭章低下头，嘴角带着浅柔的笑。
在她偎进他怀里的时候，那双手便不老实地钻进了他的长衫，温凉的指尖抚上他清韧的腰。
她像从前一样坏心，用柔柔的指尖在他腰侧轻轻地划过，引得他低笑出声，痒也忍了，由着她戏闹。
然而，在她欲以这种轻松的方式亲近他时，他落在她面上的目光却是那样的专注。
这眼神让她怔在那里，手上的戏闹也停了，轻轻地放在他的腰腹间。
自重逢以来，他什么也没有问她，可这不代表他心里没有任何想法。
一个男人，一个女人，在一个屋檐下生活几年，不可能没点什么。
何况那人还是阿伏干，他怀揣的目的，陆铭章很清楚，否则当初也不会那样难交涉，迫得他不得不借兵。
他一句不问，一句不提，他甚至不让她说，自己将所有的情绪闷在心里，那么这件事情就不存在，他不需要知道。
他的目光那样认真，从她的眉眼一点点游走，最后停在她的唇。
她想，要不要告诉他，告诉他，其实什么也没有，没有那些不堪。
她没有说，不说了，说出来有些“此地无银”的意味。
再者，他一个大男人都不问一问，没道理她一妇人急不可耐地去解释这些。
他和她之间，没必要多这个口，从前已经过去，他不想让她提，不想听，那她便不提了，那人，那事，那些过往，已是烧过后的灰烬。
他们当下拥有彼此，就是最好。
陆铭章抬手，指尖描过她弯弯的眉，再从眉尾落到她的眼尾，以指腹揾了揾。
他修长的指沿着脸廓游走到她小巧的下巴，用指腹轻轻托住。
低下头，吻她。
相接的一瞬间，两人的心神皆是一颤，那颤动牵动对方。
他的一只手托住她的腰肢，她将头微仰，他的吻随即落到那纤长的颈间。
戴缨微睁眼，将他抵开，直起身，一只手插入他那生了银丝的发中，去吻他的鬓角。
他的双手则在她的腰腹间轻抚，这轻抚，不是情欲使然，而是一种心疼和讨好。
戴缨往后退开一点，望向他的眼，将气息平缓，说道：“你不愿听，我也就不说了，但有一样，夫君得知道。”
陆铭章“嗯”了一声，示意她说。
“阿婠是你的女儿，你得认她，莫要薄待她。”她说道，“这孩子性子有些虎气，但她那模样不会错，那眼睛，那嘴巴，就是按你的样子来的。”
陆铭章轻笑出声，说道：“是么？我怎么没瞧见她哪里像我，那头发反正没传我的，又软又稀少，还有眼睛……好像也不是那么黑……还有那脾气……不像我，也不像你……”
戴缨柳眉一立，就要发作，陆铭章笑着将她往怀里拉了一下：“逗你呢，我知道的。”
“你知道？”她问，他的每一句，她都听得无比仔细。
content_en:
Dai Ying placed her daughter in a side room, which was a room separated from the main house.
She carefully placed her on the couch, covered her with a thin quilt, gave some instructions to the palace maid who was keeping watch, and left the side room with Lu Mingzhang.
It was getting late, and the two of them no longer drank and chatted with each other. Instead, they rinsed their mouths with fragrant tea and went to bed.
Lu Mingzhang lowered the curtain. The curtain was made of very light lotus-colored gauze. When it was lowered, it looked like a thin layer of mist. As soon as he turned around, she leaned over and wrapped her soft arms around his waist.
"Ayan..." She liked to call him like this, as if by calling him like this, she could have him as a boy and as he was in his prime.
Lu Mingzhang lowered his head with a soft smile on his lips.
When she snuggled into his arms, her hands sneaked into his gown, and her warm fingertips touched his clear waist.
She was as evil as before, gently stroking his waist with her soft fingertips, causing him to chuckle, and he tolerated the itch and allowed her to play with him.
However, when she wanted to get close to him in such a relaxed way, his gaze on her face was so focused.
The look in her eyes made her froze, and she stopped playing with her hands and placed them gently on his waist.
He hasn't asked her anything since their reunion, but that doesn't mean he doesn't have anything on his mind.
It is impossible for a man and a woman to live together under the same roof for several years and not have anything.
What's more, that person was Afu Gan, and Lu Mingzhang knew his purpose very well, otherwise it wouldn't have been so difficult to negotiate in the first place, forcing him to borrow troops.
He didn't ask a word, didn't mention a word, he didn't even let her say that if he kept all his emotions in his heart, then this matter didn't exist and he didn't need to know.
His eyes were so serious, wandering from her brows to her eyes, and finally stopped at her lips.
She wondered if she should tell him, tell him that in fact there was nothing, nothing unbearable.
She didn't say it, she didn't say it any more, it sounded like "there is no silver here".
Furthermore, he, a grown man, didn't even ask, so there was no reason for her, a woman, to be so impatient to explain all this.
There was no need to talk about it between him and her. The past was past, and he didn't want her to mention it. If he didn't want to hear it, then she wouldn't mention it. That person, that thing, and those past were already burned ashes.
It's best for them to have each other now.
Lu Mingzhang raised his hand, traced her curved eyebrows with his fingertips, and then touched from the end of her eyebrows to the end of her eyes with his fingertips.
His slender fingers wandered along the face to her small chin, and he gently held it with his fingertips.
Lower your head and kiss her.
The moment they met, their hearts trembled, and the trembling affected each other.
One of his hands held her waist, she tilted her head slightly, and his kiss immediately fell on her slender neck.
Dai Ying opened her eyes slightly, pushed him away, stood up straight, inserted one hand into his silver hair, and kissed his temples.
His hands were caressing her waist and abdomen. This caressing was not out of lust, but a feeling of distress and flattery.
Dai Ying stepped back a little, looked into his eyes, calmed her breath, and said, "If you don't want to listen, I won't say anything, but there is one thing that your husband must know."
Lu Mingzhang said "hmm" and motioned for her to speak.
"Ah Huan is your daughter. You have to recognize her and don't treat her poorly." She said, "This child has a bit of a bad temper, but her appearance is unmistakable. Those eyes and mouth are just like you."
Lu Mingzhang chuckled and said, "Really? Why don't I see anything about her that looks like me? Her hair is not like mine anyway, it's soft and sparse, and her eyes... don't seem that dark... and her temper... doesn't look like me, nor like you..."
Dai Ying's eyebrows were raised and she was about to have an attack. Lu Mingzhang smiled and pulled her into his arms: "I'm teasing you, I know."
"You know?" she asked, listening to every word he said very carefully.
title_en: Chapter 643 Ah Huan is your daughter Chapter 642 Don’t tell me if I don’t ask you
